description: Authority hierarchy for spec files. When two docs disagree, the higher-level file wins. Specs are authoritative over code.

cascade.label: PRD
cascade.authority: product intent, goals, JTBD, feature scope

cascade.label: STORIES
cascade.authority: acceptance criteria, data contracts, entry states

cascade.label: INPUTS
cascade.authority: control types, validation rules, defaults, downstream contracts

cascade.label: ARCHITECTURE
cascade.authority: implementation contracts, data flow, error recovery

cascade.label: AGENT_SYSTEM
cascade.authority: build orchestration, task ordering, agent roles

cascade.label: CODE
cascade.authority: runtime behavior — but specs override intent

rules.planned_change: Higher level wins. Change flows downward through consumers.
rules.bug_discovery: Code fix applied immediately. All upstream levels flagged STALE for review.
rules.value_conflict: FIELD_REGISTRY.json is canonical for shared values. All files must match.
rules.new_file_type: Defaults to level of its nearest neighbor in the cascade. /evolve proposes exact placement.
